## Setup

Libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytuesdayR)
library(janitor)
library(ggtext)
library(systemfonts)
library(showtext)
library(scales)
library(tidytext)

```

Fonts
```{r}
font_add_google(
  name = "Inter", 
  family = "inter"
)

font_add_google(
  name = "PT Sans Caption", 
  family = "ptsans"
)

# enable `ggplot` to use google fonts
showtext.auto()

```

## Data
```{r}
tuesdata <- tidytuesdayR::tt_load('2026-09-29')
health <- tuesdata$health

```


## Tidy & Explore

```{r}
health |> 
  summarise(rows = nrow(health), 
            columns = ncol(health))

health |> 
  head(100)

```

Explore categories 
```{r}
# income groups
health |> 
  group_by(GC_DEV_WIG_2025) |> 
  summarise(n = n()) # 4 income groups

# regions
health |> 
  group_by(GC_DEV_USR_2025) |> 
  summarise(n = n())

# hospitals per capita
health |> 
  drop_na(HL_FPC_HOS_2025) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = HL_FPC_HOS_2025)) + 
  geom_histogram()

# hospitals per km2 (urban center area), by category
health |> 
  drop_na(HL_FDE_HOS_2024) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = HL_FDE_HOS_2024))+
  geom_histogram() + 
  facet_grid(~GC_DEV_WIG_2025 )

# hospitals per km2 by region
health |> 
  drop_na() |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = HL_FDE_HOS_2024)) +
  geom_histogram()+
  facet_grid(~GC_DEV_USR_2025)
  
# hospitals per capita vs population 
health |> 
  select(c(GC_UCN_MAI_2025, GC_UCA_KM2_2025, HL_FPC_HOS_2025, GC_CNT_GAD_2025, GC_POP_TOT_2025, GC_DEV_WIG_2025)) |> 
  drop_na() |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = HL_FPC_HOS_2025,  x = GC_POP_TOT_2025, color = GC_DEV_WIG_2025)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(~GC_DEV_WIG_2025)
  
# proximity to hospital
health |> 
  drop_na() |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = GC_DEV_USR_2025 , y= HL_SHP_HOS_2025)) + 
  geom_point() 

```

It's probably true that it's much harder to access a hospital or pharmacy in subsaharan Africa than the developed world, but what's the actual disparity? 

```{r}
# un-grouped
health |> 
  drop_na() |> 
  mutate(hosp_per_100k_2025 = HL_FPC_HOS_2025*100000, 
         rx_per_100k_2025 = HL_FPC_PHA_2025*100000) |> 
  select(GC_DEV_USR_2025, hosp_per_100k_2025, rx_per_100k_2025) |> 
  pivot_longer(hosp_per_100k_2025:rx_per_100k_2025, names_to = 'Hospital_or_Pharmacy') |> 
  mutate(Hospital_or_Pharmacy = if_else(Hospital_or_Pharmacy == "hosp_per_100k_2025", "Hospital", "Pharmacy")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = GC_DEV_USR_2025, y = value, fill = Hospital_or_Pharmacy)) + 
  geom_boxplot()


# grouped
plot_data <- 
  health |> 
  drop_na() |>
  mutate(hosp_per_100k_2025 = HL_FPC_HOS_2025*100000, 
         rx_per_100k_2025 = HL_FPC_PHA_2025*100000) |> 
  group_by(GC_DEV_USR_2025) |> 
  summarise(mean_hosp_per_100k_2025 = mean(hosp_per_100k_2025), 
            mean_rx_per_100k_2025 = mean(rx_per_100k_2025)) |> 
  rename(region = GC_DEV_USR_2025) |> 
  pivot_longer(mean_hosp_per_100k_2025:mean_rx_per_100k_2025, names_to = "Hospital_or_Pharmacy") |> 
  mutate(Hospital_or_Pharmacy = if_else(Hospital_or_Pharmacy == "mean_hosp_per_100k_2025", "Hospital", "Pharmacy")) |> 
  mutate(Hospital_or_Pharmacy = factor(Hospital_or_Pharmacy, levels = c("Hospital", "Pharmacy"))) |> 
  mutate(region_sorted = reorder_within(region, value, Hospital_or_Pharmacy))
  

plot_data |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = region, y = value, fill = Hospital_or_Pharmacy)) + 
  geom_col(position = "dodge") 


```

## Plot

Double-panel lollipop plot. 
```{r}
hospital_color <- "#64748B"
pharmacy_color <- "#D97706"

plot_data |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = value, 
             y =  region_sorted)) + 
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = value, y = region_sorted, yend = region_sorted)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = Hospital_or_Pharmacy), size = 3.5) +
  scale_y_reordered()+
  facet_wrap(~Hospital_or_Pharmacy, scales = "free_y") + 
  # remove padding on x axis
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)), 
                     labels = label_number(accuracy = 1)) + 
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Hospital" = hospital_color, 
               "Pharmacy" = pharmacy_color)
  ) + 
  labs(y = "",
       x = "Facilities per 100k People", 
       title = "<span style='color:#64748B;'>Hospitals</span> and <span style='color:#D97706;'>Pharmacies</span> per Capita, by Region",
       subtitle = "Rates per 100K Population, 2025 Data") +
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "lightgray", linewidth = 0.6), 
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "lightgray", linewidth = 0.6), 
    plot.title.position = "plot", 
    plot.subtitle = element_text(family = "inter", size = 12),
    plot.title = element_markdown(family = "inter", size = 18, face = "bold"), 
    element_rect(color = "#F5F3D7")
    )

```
